candidates.description: Presence of homozygous deletion or biallelic loss of the CDKN2A gene.
candidates.extraction_instruction: Search the Genomic Findings or Molecular Profile sections for 'CDKN2A' and identify if 'homozygous deletion', 'homozygous loss', or 'biallelic loss' is documented.
candidates.measurement_definition: Positive if the genomic profile reports 'homozygous deletion' or 'homozygous loss' of CDKN2A (specifically exons 1-3); negative if no such loss is reported in the molecular profile.
candidates.name: cdkn2a_homozygous_deletion
candidates.uncertainty: It is unclear if deletions of specific exons other than 1-3 are considered equivalent for the purposes of this variable.

candidates.description: Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status score reflecting the patient's level of functional impairment.
candidates.extraction_instruction: Locate the 'Performance Status' or 'Assessment' section and extract the numeric value associated with 'ECOG'.
candidates.measurement_definition: The numeric ECOG score as documented in the clinical assessment or performance status section.
candidates.name: ecog_performance_status
candidates.uncertainty: The evidence does not specify if the ECOG score was assessed at a single baseline timepoint or if it changed prior to the primary clinical assessment.

limitations: TMB and PD-L1 were mentioned but lacked consistent numeric reporting across all provided patients to establish a robust continuous baseline definition.
Sample size of patients in the provided excerpts is small, limiting the diversity of observed ECOG scores.
summary: The provided evidence suggests that genomic alterations, specifically CDKN2A homozygous deletion, and baseline functional status, measured by the ECOG performance scale, are consistent clinical features across the patient cohort.
